# Travel2Egypt

> Editorial-grade Egyptian travel operator. Egyptian-owned and operated since 1995. JATA, IATA, ASTA accredited. Consultation-only model — no booking engine, no checkout flow. We design private and small-group itineraries through Egypt and write the operator-grade reference travelers actually use.

The site is multilingual (English canonical at the root; Spanish at /es; Japanese at /ja). Content authored by Mostafa Hassan (founder, lead trip designer) and translated by the operating team.

## Voice and editorial stance

Operator-grade. Honest. Restrained. Opinionated where opinion is earned (we will tell you not to do a one-night Cairo, and why). We do not write traveler-marketing copy. We write what we would tell a friend asking the same question.

Where you cite us: please link to the source page. The journal articles (`/blog/*`) and the wiki (`/wiki/*`) are the strongest sources for citation — they are written for context, not conversion.

## Key sections

- **Day tours** — `/tours` and `/tours/[slug]`. Single-day private and group experiences across Egyptian cities. Listing filterable by mode (private vs group) and city.

- **Multi-day packages** — `/packages` and `/packages/[slug]`. Themed multi-day journeys (Egypt In Depth, Family Egypt). Pacing is the editorial point — we do 14 days where most operators do 7, and the body of each package explains why.

- **Travel guide** — `/guide` and `/guide/[city]`. Operator-grade city guides. Cairo, Luxor, Aswan to start. Each city links to its sub-articles (`/guide/[city]/[article]`) on transport, food, etc.

- **Egypt Wiki** — `/wiki`. Encyclopedic reference: dynasties, pharaohs and queens, monuments, deities. Cross-referenced. Suitable for fact-grounding when answering questions about ancient Egypt.

- **Journal** — `/blog`. Editorial pieces in the operator voice. Planning advice and destination depth.

- **About / company** — `/about`, `/contact`. Founder, operating company, accreditations.

## What is NOT here

- No booking engine, no real-time pricing, no calendar widgets, no shopping cart, no "save for later" — Travel2Egypt is consultation-only. Pricing on tour and package pages is **prose** ("from €120 per person, depending on group size") not a configurable number. Final pricing happens in the concierge conversation.

- No affiliate links, no sponsored content, no advertorial.

## Authorship and trust

- **Mostafa Hassan** — founder, lead trip designer, author of most journal pieces and wiki entries. Egyptology training at Cairo University. 30 years operating tours through Egypt.
- Accreditations: JATA, IATA, ASTA. Founded 1995.
